summary: Testing My Expenses with Monthly Report PDF Download feature. All backend APIs pass. Frontend UI verified - My Expenses shows expenses with correct amounts, meeting expenses show travel details (mode, km, lead name), Monthly Expense Report section is expandable with Load Report and Download PDF buttons.
features_tested: My Expenses page shows all expenses with correct amounts (26 expense cards)
Meeting expenses show travel details (DRIVING, TWO_WHEELER, TRANSIT, km, Round Trip, Lead Name)
Monthly Expense Report section is visible and expandable
Load Report button fetches expense data for selected month
Download PDF button present and enabled when data exists
GET /api/my/expenses returns expenses with summary (pending, approved, total_amount)
GET /api/expenses/report/monthly-meeting-expenses returns report with summary and expense details
Notifications endpoint accessible for expense approval flow
Pricing Plan validation returns structured errors (frontend maps to user-friendly labels)

test_details.travel_indicators_shown: PASS - Meeting, km, DRIVING, TWO_WHEELER, Round Trip visible
test_details.monthly_report_section_found: PASS - Monthly Expense Report section expandable
test_details.load_report_button_works: PASS - Load Report button clicked successfully

critical_code_review_comments: Pricing Plan validation mapping in PricingPlanBuilder.js correctly transforms technical field names to user-friendly labels
context_for_next_testing_agent: Monthly Expense Report with PDF download feature verified. My Expenses page shows meeting expenses with travel details. API endpoint /api/expenses/report/monthly-meeting-expenses returns all required fields for PDF generation (lead_name, company, stage, expense_date, travel_mode, distance_km, amount, status, payroll_linked). jsPDF library is used for client-side PDF generation. Pricing Plan validation properly maps field names to user-friendly labels.

my_expenses_page.expense_details: Shows travel mode, km, lead name for meeting expenses
my_expenses_page.monthly_report_section: Expandable with month selector, Load Report, Download PDF buttons
